scope: UDP 1400-byte unique echo bodies executed inside ordinary Windows containers; fresh/reused/fresh sockets, 100 attempts per phase
finding: Both Windows versions timed out after successful requests on a reused socket. New socket creation is not required for the observed timeout.
limitations: No packet capture in this experiment; timeout location and root cause are unproven.
The preceding HostProcess compartment experiment did not deliver observable requests and was stopped; it is excluded from these results.
Only sequential traffic and one payload size; no sustained reliability qualification.
